application.name: holoscan_camera_v4l2
application.description: Python graph using the native V4L2 operator to capture typed Image samples

changelog.0.1.0: SDK 5 Python graph validation, live YUYV capture, and Holoviz preview through V4l2CaptureOp

requirements.python: CPython 3.12 or newer with matching Holoscan SDK 5 Python bindings and nanobind 3.0.1
requirements.linux: V4L2 capture device exposing a YUYV mode for live capture
requirements.preview: Matching Holoscan Visualization Python bindings, NumPy, and a compatible NVIDIA GPU and graphical display

validate.description: Compile the Python V4L2 graph without opening a camera

capture.description: Capture 120 YUYV frames from /dev/video0 with a Python consumer

preview.description: Show captured frames until the preview window closes
